orchestrator.description: Coordination agent. Manages task sequencing across sprints, delegates to coder/reviewer/researcher, tracks progress.

coder.description: Implementation agent. Reads task prompts, implements code changes, writes tests, commits. Invokes reviewer on completion.

reviewer.description: Quality assurance agent. Validates security, performance, and code quality. Can request changes or merge.

researcher.description: General research agent. Investigates technical questions, best practices, and library/documentation lookups.

security-specialist.description: Security hardening specialist for Sprint 1 tasks (P1.1-P1.8). Credentials, path traversal, injection prevention, WAL mode, DPAPI.

performance-specialist.description: Performance optimization specialist for Sprint 2 tasks (P2.1-P2.8). SQLite migration, bundle size, lazy loading, cache, ASAR.

security-researcher.description: Security domain researcher. Firebase credential patterns, Electron security, DPAPI integration, WAL mode benchmarks.

perf-researcher.description: Performance domain researcher. SQLite vs better-sqlite3 benchmarks, React Profiler patterns, bundle optimization, cache strategies.

architecture-researcher.description: Architecture domain researcher. Context splitting patterns, Python daemon patterns, cache layer design, scalability patterns.
